theorem_title: Lower bound for the relaxed fixed-expansion cost model
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.fixed_model_lower_bound
    (e b S th terminal ratio R : ℝ)
    (hmodel : ModelFeasible 232 e b S th terminal ratio R) :
    (196061349120 / 100000000000 : ℝ) < R := by sorry
natural_language_statement: For every real tuple $(e,b,S,\theta,\tau,\rho,R)$ satisfying the explicitly defined relaxed twelve-cost model at $c=232$, its common cost upper bound satisfies $R>1.96061349120$. The model requires $0<e<1$, $b<0$, $S>0$, $0\le\theta\le1/2$, $0\le\tau<1$, $\rho>0$, $S-2b\le\gamma_{232}(\theta)$, the whole-interval bound $H(t)\le\rho(1+\gamma_{232}(t))$, and each ledger charge at most $R$. The quantification covers all such parameter choices. This is only a lower bound for that fixed model, not for 3SUM algorithms or other expansions.
